notes.title: Goggles on! Builder Simulator VR is Live!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Builders![/h1]

Today is the day we’ve been waiting for!
[b]Builder Simulator VR[/b] is finally [b]Live[/b] for you to play!
We can’t wait to hear about your first impressions of the game, but before that let’s take a look at the premiere Trailer!

[previewyoutube=eOGtjWYf1hw;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2270940/Builder_Simulator_VR/

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Just for a quick reminder.[/h3]
[b]Builder Simulator[/b] is a game about designing your houses, building them from scratch, and finally when everything is in place - furnishing them.
In [b]Builder Simulator VR[/b] you’ll be doing everything I just mentioned, but completely in Virtual Reality! Players that already played the base game will feel right at home.

[h3]Bundles[/h3]
We’ve also prepared a few [b]Bundles[/b] to celebrate the release!
(Remember that the owners of Builder Simulator will have a 50% off from one of them!)

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48618/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48617/

And with that in mind Thank you for sticking with us till the end!
Now enjoy the game by yourself and be sure to let us know your feedback!

[i]Cheers!
~Jacob and the Developers Team[/i]

notes.title: Prepare your goggles! It’s nearly time to build in VR!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Future Builders![/h1]

We’re excited to announce that the [b]Builder Simulator VR[/b] is releasing on the [b]16th of December[/b]!

[u][b]Check out what’s going on in the VR version![/b][/u]

[previewyoutube=PUjlnYox-9g;full][/previewyoutube]

For those of you who played the original Builder Simulator, the main mechanics of the game haven’t changed much. It’s just your beloved simulator all over again just in a new format!
But for those of you who never had a chance to play the base game…
Prepare for a blast of a time!
Builder Simulator is all about building houses from scratch. Plan your house, prepare the foundations, build brick by brick and finish it all off with the furniture!

We’ll be also preparing some Bundles for you but more on that on the premiere day… [i](For those who already own the non-VR game there will be a 50% discount for the VR version!)[/i]

And with that in mind Thank you for sticking with us till the end!
Be sure to stay on the lookout for more information about the release next week!

[i]Cheers!
~Jacob and the Developers Team[/i]
